response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan) SELECT time_in_force, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () - AVG(order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER ()) OVER () AS share_diff_from_avg FROM c
